title: Compat API v1.50: DELETE /images platforms
body:
Docker Engine API [v1.50](https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v150-api-changes) has one remaining Compat gap before we can treat 1.50 as covered under the parent epic (claim v1.55).
## Needs work
### `DELETE /images/{name}?platforms=`
- Accept an array of JSON-encoded OCI Platform objects to delete platform-specific content from a multi-platform image/index.
- Today Compat remove only accepts `force` / `noprune` / `ignore`, and image remove options have no Platforms field.
## Checklist
- [ ] `DELETE /images/{name}?platforms=`
## Contributing
If you want to work on this checklist item, please open a focused issue and PR and reference **this** issue (and the parent epic).
## References
- https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v150-api-changes

comments.body: Hi @Honny1, I’d like to take this up. My plan is to update ImageRemoveOptions to accept platform filters, parse the JSON-encoded platforms query parameter in the Compat DELETE /images handler, and implement the manifest list pruning logic in the ABI engine. I’ll open a draft PR referencing this issue and #30159 once I have an initial implementation and tests.
@jain-aadi Sure, but please follow the Contributing instructions. Thanks.
